note: Empty by design. Every WordPress-vs-static difference encountered so far turned out to be genuinely inert and is handled in tools/normalise.mjs, where it is documented and covered by a self-test assertion — rather than waived here. An entry in this list means "we accept a real difference"; needing one should prompt a hard look first. Each entry requires a pattern, a reason and a maxCount, and is printed in every report.
